scope: Highest reported artifacts from GEMSDOE24,25,27,28,30,31,32,33,36; comparison is limited to these nine repositories and their 17 fetched public TIFF variants.

decision.reason: The pinned 17GEMSDOE witness is positive on all 5,167,373 finite sample-footprint cells; any nonempty in-footprint candidate has 100% literal overlap, above the 70% stop. No placement, new TIFF, or holdout was run.

comparison_method.retrieval: GitHub Git Blob API; Git blob SHA-1 and local SHA-256 verified; current main tree entries rechecked at the commit listed for each repository.
comparison_method.normalisation: Read the 0/1 prediction support only within the finite sample-submission footprint; outside-footprint encoding differences do not count as different predictions.
comparison_method.overlap: Directional fraction of candidate positive pixels with a positive registry pixel within Euclidean 3-pixel radius.
comparison_method.correlation: Binary-support rank correlation (Spearman midrank / phi for 0/1 masks).
comparison_method.selected_raster_format: All nine selected comparison references passed 9/9 shared strict format-only gates: CRS, shape, transform, band/dtype, [0,1] range, no NaN inside, valid outside values, all finite/zeros outside submission encoding, and reread SHA-256.
comparison_method.format_gate_limit: No catalogue or holdout test was run on these historical reference files. Format pass is not scientific or submission clearance.
comparison_method.pairwise_threshold_summary: All 36 target-site pairs breach the configured symmetric pairwise stop: at least one directed 3-pixel overlap exceeds 70% or |binary-support rank correlation| exceeds 0.90. Each site row also names a candidate-directed failing witness.

strongest_reference.score_evidence: OWNER-REPORT / CLAIM; no organizer submission-page receipt binds score to raster.
strongest_reference.local_lineage: Exact local parent R0 file; verified set lineage H19-5 (121,131) -> D2.8 (44,090) -> H27-4 SOLO (40,199) -> R0 (37,654). R0 is exactly D2.8 & distance-to-catalogue > 2 px; SOLO is exactly D2.8 & distance > 1 px.
strongest_reference.mechanism_status: Plausible DTI mechanism, not causal proof: 300 m triangular max-kernel saturates nearby truth credit; Poisson thinning may remove redundant false-positive mass; a >2 px catalogue collar avoids known-fault placements. Hidden truth and score receipt are unavailable.

conflicting_unverified_claims.source: GEMSDOE32 owner-maintained page, retrieved via GitHub API at commit 8b00ee91b9d6d7ef0e3762eb7bc0c92bee0928d1

leaderboard_claims.decision: Do not state a current official leader; the values conflict and no live organizer leaderboard was verified in this environment.

score_receipt_and_metadata_flags.status: Owner page labels 0.2778 as a claim and says no submission-page receipt binds it to the raster; page says already submitted/do not resubmit.
Owner-maintained file named receipt-...json gives an expected DTI range, not a scored organizer receipt; its stored note is 158 characters, exceeding the 140-character form limit.
